p2/esc1091:0.speaker: seeker
p2/esc1091:0.text: Hello. I wanted to talk about my academic pressures.

p2/esc1091:1.speaker: supporter
p2/esc1091:1.text: Hi there. What academic pressures are troubling you today?

p2/esc1091:10.speaker: seeker
p2/esc1091:10.text: What should I do to relax my mind?

p2/esc1091:11.speaker: supporter
p2/esc1091:11.text: Have you thought about seeking advice from a close friend or family member?

p2/esc1091:12.speaker: seeker
p2/esc1091:12.text: Not yet, I am scared to tell my family, considering that they view academic success heavily

p2/esc1091:13.speaker: seeker
p2/esc1091:13.text: With friends, most are busy with their own struggles and I don't want to be bothering them as much

p2/esc1091:14.speaker: supporter
p2/esc1091:14.text: I see, it sounds like you are dealing with your academic pressures all on your own right now then?

p2/esc1091:15.speaker: seeker
p2/esc1091:15.text: Totally. Feels pretty tiring and heavy

p2/esc1091:16.speaker: supporter
p2/esc1091:16.text: Is there possibly a school councilor you could seek advice from?

p2/esc1091:17.speaker: seeker
p2/esc1091:17.text: Maybe, but it feels scary and very awkward to seek them

p2/esc1091:18.speaker: supporter
p2/esc1091:18.text: I hear you, it's definitely not for everyone.

p2/esc1091:19.speaker: seeker
p2/esc1091:19.text: thank you for understanding and talking with me

p2/esc1091:2.speaker: seeker
p2/esc1091:2.text: Just lots of classes and expectations. Especially with group projects.

p2/esc1091:20.speaker: supporter
p2/esc1091:20.text: Of course! We all need an ear to listen once in a while :)

p2/esc1091:21.speaker: seeker
p2/esc1091:21.text: It really helps to get this off my chest

p2/esc1091:22.speaker: supporter
p2/esc1091:22.text: I'm so happy to hear that, it sounds like this was something building up. It's always good to let things out in one way or another.

p2/esc1091:24.speaker: supporter
p2/esc1091:24.text: Is there anything else you would like to talk about today?

p2/esc1091:27.speaker: supporter
p2/esc1091:27.text: Okay, and of course! I'm glad I could help.

p2/esc1091:3.speaker: seeker
p2/esc1091:3.text: Needed someone to talk to about my stress and workload. I don't know what to do with these horrible group members.

p2/esc1091:4.speaker: supporter
p2/esc1091:4.text: I see. It sounds like being in the group project is especially stressing you out. Would you say that's pretty true?

p2/esc1091:5.speaker: seeker
p2/esc1091:5.text: Yes. I have roughly 3 different classes all requiring a group project.

p2/esc1091:6.speaker: supporter
p2/esc1091:6.text: I totally understand. When I was in school I remember being stressed out when we had mandatory group projects as well. Having to deal with others can be a bit stressful at times.

p2/esc1091:7.speaker: seeker
p2/esc1091:7.text: I agree. I also just don't know which project to proritize

p2/esc1091:8.speaker: supporter
p2/esc1091:8.text: I hear you, it sounds like you have a lot going on.

p2/esc150:0.speaker: supporter
p2/esc150:0.text: hi there! how are you feeling today?

p2/esc150:10.speaker: supporter
p2/esc150:10.text: It sounds like writing your feelings down helped you greatly in the past. May I suggest going back to writing and even letting someone you trust read what you have written down to understand how you are feeling?

p2/esc150:11.speaker: seeker
p2/esc150:11.text: yes, writing has been a huge help for me. I would take your suggestion and begin writing again to feel better. and i have let others read what i wrote and they have said it has helped them get over their depression and helped them understand me more

p2/esc150:12.speaker: supporter
p2/esc150:12.text: That's great! I am glad to hear that you will begin writing again. Thank you for opening up to me about your feelings. How do you feel about the solution we have come to today?

p2/esc150:13.speaker: seeker
p2/esc150:13.text: now that i was able to talk about how i feel with you and you giving me a useful suggestion i feel less depressed and feel motivated to write again. your help has been really helpful for me

p2/esc150:14.speaker: supporter
p2/esc150:14.text: That's wonderful! I appreciate your honesty about how you are feeling. I am proud of you for seeking help. Is there anything else you would like to discuss?

p2/esc150:15.speaker: seeker
p2/esc150:15.text: thank you so much for helping me. and that is all that i would like to discuss. you have been a big help for me

p2/esc150:16.speaker: supporter
p2/esc150:16.text: I am glad I could be here for you! I am hoping you continue to feel better and your writing helps to work out these feelings.  Thank you so much for being open with me. I hope you have a fantastic rest of your day! :)

p2/esc150:17.speaker: seeker
p2/esc150:17.text: thank you. hope you enjoy your day

p2/esc150:2.speaker: supporter
p2/esc150:2.text: i'm sorry to hear that. is there a specific reason you are having these feelings?

p2/esc150:3.speaker: seeker
p2/esc150:3.text: i feel alone. i feel like i do not have anyone to talk to when it comes to my emotions.

p2/esc150:4.speaker: supporter
p2/esc150:4.text: I understand. I have been feeling quite lonely too, I find myself feeling lonely at work and struggling to find someone I trust to talk to about these emotions. Do you have a friend or family member that you trust who might understand some of these feelings?

p2/esc150:5.speaker: seeker
p2/esc150:5.text: i do have a few friends that i think i can talk to about how i am feeling however the thought of them being too busy with their work is what prevents me from reaching out to them.

p2/esc150:6.speaker: supporter
p2/esc150:6.text: I understand. Correct me if i'm wrong, it sounds like you're nervous to open up to these trusted people because you think they might be distracted by their work to provide the empathy you need and fully understand how you are feeling. Does that sound right?

p2/esc150:7.speaker: seeker
p2/esc150:7.text: you know i think that you are right about this. it has always been difficult for me to open to others even with those that have been there for me when i needed someone. i feel like a mix of emotions nervous but at the same time wanting to reaching out for help

p2/esc150:8.speaker: supporter
p2/esc150:8.text: I understand these feelings very well. Sometimes, my fear overshadows my want for help. I find it easier to open up to others through writing rather than face to face. Have you considered putting your feelings in writing and opening up to trusted friends and family in this way?

p2/esc150:9.speaker: seeker
p2/esc150:9.text: i have been writing for a while but due to my emotions i have stopped writing like i used to. when i did write i did notice a change in my feelings it became more positive and less depressed. now that i stopped writing its like i went back into depression

p2/esc611:1.speaker: seeker
p2/esc611:1.text: hi. my friend told my ex boyfriend he was an idiot for dumping me. it made me feel uncomfortable since i was in the same room. now he is talking to me again. i think he might want me back

p2/esc611:10.speaker: supporter
p2/esc611:10.text: Do you feel his change is genuine?

p2/esc611:11.speaker: seeker
p2/esc611:11.text: to a degree. i think he has ulterior motives too.

p2/esc611:12.speaker: supporter
p2/esc611:12.text: What would he have to do to prove himself?

p2/esc611:13.speaker: seeker
p2/esc611:13.text: say he wants me back or something to that effect. i'd like him to be more direct in what he wants from me

p2/esc611:14.speaker: supporter
p2/esc611:14.text: It sounds like it would help if he were direct with you and not sending mixed signals.  Is that correct?

p2/esc611:15.speaker: seeker
p2/esc611:15.text: yes that would be nice. he tends to beat around the bush then lets me know

p2/esc611:16.speaker: supporter
p2/esc611:16.text: Have you talked to anyone else besides your friend about your concerns?  Do you think your family or other friends could give some additional support to you?

p2/esc611:17.speaker: seeker
p2/esc611:17.text: yes i've talked to them about it. they've given me some insight into it. i know they want me to be careful. they don't want me to be hurt

p2/esc611:18.speaker: supporter
p2/esc611:18.text: That's understandable that they want you to be careful.  My parents and friends watched out for me too.

p2/esc611:19.speaker: seeker
p2/esc611:19.text: we are lucky they look out for us. they can't all be wrong if they're guiding us a certain way

p2/esc611:2.speaker: supporter
p2/esc611:2.text: What are your thoughts on the relationship?

p2/esc611:20.speaker: supporter
p2/esc611:20.text: I think you hit the nail on the head that it's helpful to have that support.

p2/esc611:21.speaker: seeker
p2/esc611:21.text: absolutely. i appreciate your help! nity nite

p2/esc611:22.speaker: supporter
p2/esc611:22.text: Thanks.  Can I assist you with anything else?

p2/esc611:3.speaker: seeker
p2/esc611:3.text: my feelings fluctuate. i resent him that he ended it. it confuses me he still wants to be in my life. he said he wanted to be friends but then asked me out again. i think he is trying to work his way back in. i know i can't keep it up unless he makes it clear he wants to be with me. i don't have time for games

p2/esc611:4.speaker: supporter
p2/esc611:4.text: That does sound hard that he is giving mixed signals.

p2/esc611:5.speaker: seeker
p2/esc611:5.text: yeah i don't like that. neither does my friend. why she told him he is an idiot for letting me go

p2/esc611:6.speaker: supporter
p2/esc611:6.text: Do you think he took your friend's comments seriously?

p2/esc611:7.speaker: seeker
p2/esc611:7.text: yes cuz that's when he wanted me to be around him more

p2/esc611:8.speaker: supporter
p2/esc611:8.text: It sounds like your friend got him thinking.

p2/esc955:1.speaker: seeker
p2/esc955:1.text: I am the youngest of 5 siblings and I feel all most days now because of my parents

p2/esc955:10.speaker: seeker
p2/esc955:10.text: I do feel anxious every time.

p2/esc955:11.speaker: seeker
p2/esc955:11.text: I tried a couple of times, but my mom always sees it as being too sensitive

p2/esc955:12.speaker: supporter
p2/esc955:12.text: Sometimes it can feel impossible to talk to parents

p2/esc955:13.speaker: seeker
p2/esc955:13.text: I know, is it better if I stay away for awhile? since taking to them won't make sense?

p2/esc955:14.speaker: supporter
p2/esc955:14.text: I think that it can be very healthy to get some distance, but I think it can also feel difficult -- do you have good friends in your life that you could lean on if you needed some distance from your parents?

p2/esc955:15.speaker: seeker
p2/esc955:15.text: Yes, I do. They actually helped me coped up. I always think that I wasn't blessed with my family, but I'm blessed with good friends

p2/esc955:16.speaker: supporter
p2/esc955:16.text: Good friends can be a huge comfort and it sounds like you're a good friends yourself if you have those kinds of friendships

p2/esc955:17.speaker: seeker
p2/esc955:17.text: Thinking about it, they really did help a lot. So I should really distance myself for a while right?

p2/esc955:18.speaker: supporter
p2/esc955:18.text: I think if making distance helps you feel better, you deserve and have a right to that space

p2/esc955:19.speaker: seeker
p2/esc955:19.text: Yes, thank you. I really need to that.

p2/esc955:2.speaker: supporter
p2/esc955:2.text: It sounds like you're having a hard time feeling like you have your parents' attention, is that right?

p2/esc955:21.speaker: supporter
p2/esc955:21.text: It sounds like you are making healthy and careful emotional decisions

p2/esc955:22.speaker: supporter
p2/esc955:22.text: Is there anything else you want to discuss about your parents?

p2/esc955:3.speaker: seeker
p2/esc955:3.text: Not their attention, but more on their expectations on me

p2/esc955:5.speaker: supporter
p2/esc955:5.text: Do they do or say anything specific that makes you feel those expectations?

p2/esc955:6.speaker: seeker
p2/esc955:6.text: Yes, its more on comparing me to the children of their friends. They always say why don't I have a better job or even plans on marrying rich. Stuff like that is very frustrating

p2/esc955:7.speaker: seeker
p2/esc955:7.text: They also expect me to take care of them financially soon, I'm just starting my adult life I want to enjoy it

p2/esc955:8.speaker: supporter
p2/esc955:8.text: That sounds very frustrating. I think if I felt those kind of expectations I would be anxious.

p2/esc955:9.speaker: supporter
p2/esc955:9.text: Do you feel comfortable talking to them about your feelings?

p2/p2_conv_1:0.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_1:0.text: Hey Taylor, it's good to see you here. How are you holding up these days?

p2/p2_conv_1:1.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_1:1.text: Hey. I'm managing, I guess. Just trying to keep up with everything.

p2/p2_conv_1:10.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_1:10.text: That makes sense. It's hard to navigate differences when you're emotionally invested. How does that make you feel now?

p2/p2_conv_1:11.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_1:11.text: Honestly, it's exhausting. I keep playing the argument over and over in my head, trying to make sense of it.

p2/p2_conv_1:12.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_1:12.text: I can imagine how tiring that must be. Sometimes our minds just want to find an answer, even when one isn't clear-cut.

p2/p2_conv_1:13.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_1:13.text: Exactly. It's like I'm looking for signs of who was right or wrong, but I end up just feeling more tangled.

p2/p2_conv_1:14.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_1:14.text: Maybe it's not about right or wrong but about understanding where each of you is coming from. What do you hope to achieve by unraveling these feelings?

p2/p2_conv_1:15.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_1:15.text: I'd just like to find some peace with it, I guess. Maybe closure or even a chance to talk about it calmly.

p2/p2_conv_1:16.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_1:16.text: Closure sounds like a healthy goal. Giving yourself time to process everything is important, though. Do you feel like there's space to have that calm conversation with Nate?

p2/p2_conv_1:17.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_1:17.text: Part of me hopes so, but I'm not sure if either of us is ready yet. There's still a lot of raw emotions.

p2/p2_conv_1:18.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_1:18.text: Emotions can take time to settle. It's okay to wait until it feels right. Meanwhile, how are you taking care of yourself?

p2/p2_conv_1:19.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_1:19.text: I've been writing a lot, which helps. It's been a good outlet, even if it's just jotting down how I feel.

p2/p2_conv_1:2.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_1:2.text: I hear you. With school and everything else on your plate, it must be a lot. Anything in particular that's been weighing on you?

p2/p2_conv_1:20.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_1:20.text: Writing can be really therapeutic, I agree. You have a wonderful gift for expressing your emotions through words.

p2/p2_conv_1:21.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_1:21.text: Thank you for saying that. It makes me feel less alone in all of this.

p2/p2_conv_1:22.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_1:22.text: You're definitely not alone, Taylor. I'm always here to listen whenever you need.

p2/p2_conv_1:23.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_1:23.text: I appreciate it. It means a lot to have someone to talk to who gets it.

p2/p2_conv_1:24.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_1:24.text: Anytime. Take your time with everything and remember to be kind to yourself.

p2/p2_conv_1:25.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_1:25.text: I'll try to keep that in mind. Thank you for being here for me.

p2/p2_conv_1:3.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_1:3.text: Yeah, it's mostly about Nate, my ex. We had a big argument and things have been weird since then.

p2/p2_conv_1:4.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_1:4.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. It sounds tough to go through a fallout with someone who used to mean a lot to you.

p2/p2_conv_1:5.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_1:5.text: Yeah, it really sucks. I thought we were on the same page about things, but that argument just brought up a lot of unresolved issues.

p2/p2_conv_1:6.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_1:6.text: Conflicts like that can be really revealing, but also painful. Do you feel comfortable sharing what the argument was about?

p2/p2_conv_1:7.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_1:7.text: Sure. It started off as a small disagreement about our future plans, but it escalated quickly.

p2/p2_conv_1:8.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_1:8.text: It's amazing how sometimes the smallest things become a big deal. Do you think it was more about the future or something else underlying it?

p2/p2_conv_1:9.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_1:9.text: I think it was a bit of both. We've had different ideas about our futures for a while, and maybe we were ignoring it until now.

p2/p2_conv_2:1.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_2:1.text: Hi Taylor! Yes, I'm here. What's on your mind?

p2/p2_conv_2:10.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_2:10.text: It's just hard. I used to be so confident about my writing and studies, and now I doubt everything.

p2/p2_conv_2:11.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_2:11.text: Remember, self-doubt is normal, especially when you're exhausted. But your talent and dedication are still there, even if it feels buried right now.

p2/p2_conv_2:12.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_2:12.text: I hope so. I miss feeling assured about my choices.

p2/p2_conv_2:13.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_2:13.text: You'll find that assurance again. It's sometimes about taking a step back to breathe and remind yourself of your strengths.

p2/p2_conv_2:14.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_2:14.text: Yeah, maybe I do need to take some time for myself, away from the stress.

p2/p2_conv_2:15.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_2:15.text: That's a great idea. How about planning a small break or doing something that you enjoy, just for a bit?

p2/p2_conv_2:16.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_2:16.text: I might do that. Maybe write something just for myself, not for a grade.

p2/p2_conv_2:17.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_2:17.text: That sounds like a wonderful plan. Writing for pleasure might help you reconnect with your passion.

p2/p2_conv_2:18.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_2:18.text: Thank you for listening. It's nice to have someone to talk to.

p2/p2_conv_2:19.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_2:19.text: You're welcome, anytime. Remember, you're not alone in this.

p2/p2_conv_2:2.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_2:2.text: I'm really struggling. I just can't seem to get anything right lately.

p2/p2_conv_2:20.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_2:20.text: I'll keep that in mind. Thanks again.

p2/p2_conv_2:3.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_2:3.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about what's been going on?

p2/p2_conv_2:4.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_2:4.text: Well, I failed my mid-term exam. It was really important for my grade, and now I'm just feeling overwhelmed.

p2/p2_conv_2:5.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_2:5.text: That sounds tough. It's okay to feel overwhelmed. You've been balancing a lot lately.

p2/p2_conv_2:6.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_2:6.text: Yeah, on top of that, the argument with my ex is still weighing on me. Everything feels out of control.

p2/p2_conv_2:7.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_2:7.text: It seems like there's a lot happening at once. It makes sense to feel this way when you're dealing with both academics and personal challenges.

p2/p2_conv_2:8.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_2:8.text: Exactly! It feels like I'm failing in every aspect of my life.

p2/p2_conv_2:9.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_2:9.text: You're not failing, Taylor. You're going through a very challenging time, and it's okay to not have everything together.

p2/p2_conv_3:0.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_3:0.text: Hey Taylor, how are you holding up this week?

p2/p2_conv_3:1.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_3:1.text: Hi. It's been a rough one honestly. I feel kind of isolated and anxious.

p2/p2_conv_3:10.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_3:10.text: Your feelings are valid. You're really talented, but sometimes anxiety can make you doubt what you're capable of.

p2/p2_conv_3:11.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_3:11.text: It's just hard to remember that when I feel so stuck. And isolation during exam week hasn't helped.

p2/p2_conv_3:12.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_3:12.text: Being isolated can definitely amplify those feelings. Do you have anyone you could reach out to for support?

p2/p2_conv_3:13.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_3:13.text: I guess I could talk to some classmates. We've been good study buddies in the past.

p2/p2_conv_3:14.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_3:14.text: That sounds like a great idea. Having a support system can make a huge difference.

p2/p2_conv_3:15.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_3:15.text: I'll try reaching out. I just hope I can keep it together for the rest of the exams.

p2/p2_conv_3:16.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_3:16.text: Taking one day at a time might help. I'm here whenever you need to talk though, okay?

p2/p2_conv_3:17.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_3:17.text: I appreciate that, a lot. I didn't realize how much I needed to vent until now.

p2/p2_conv_3:18.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_3:18.text: I'm glad you reached out. You're doing your best, and that's something to be proud of.

p2/p2_conv_3:19.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_3:19.text: Thanks for listening. It means more than you know.

p2/p2_conv_3:2.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_3:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Exam weeks can be really tough, especially with everything else going on.

p2/p2_conv_3:20.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_3:20.text: Anytime, Taylor. Let's catch up soon and see how you're feeling after exams, okay?

p2/p2_conv_3:21.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_3:21.text: Sounds good. I'll talk to you then.

p2/p2_conv_3:3.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_3:3.text: Yeah, that's putting it lightly. I can't shake this feeling of being overwhelmed. It's like everything's happening at once.

p2/p2_conv_3:4.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_3:4.text: That sounds incredibly stressful. Do you want to talk about what's been weighing you down the most?

p2/p2_conv_3:5.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_3:5.text: I guess it's a mix of things. I've been feeling distracted ever since the thing with my ex and then failing the mid-term.

p2/p2_conv_3:6.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_3:6.text: Those are both really big things. It makes sense that they'd still be affecting you.

p2/p2_conv_3:7.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_3:7.text: I know, but I feel like I should be able to handle it better. I mean, other people seem to.

p2/p2_conv_3:8.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_3:8.text: Everyone deals with pressure differently, and it's okay to feel like you're struggling. You're handling a lot.

p2/p2_conv_3:9.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_3:9.text: Thank you for saying that. I just keep overthinking everything, like doubting my abilities in writing and studies.

p2/p2_conv_4:0.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_4:0.text: Hey Taylor, I just wanted to check in and see how you're doing today?

p2/p2_conv_4:1.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_4:1.text: Hey, thanks for reaching out. I'm not too great, honestly.

p2/p2_conv_4:10.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_4:10.text: Leaving things unresolved can definitely add to stress. It’s tough, but maybe taking some time to plan what you want to say might help?

p2/p2_conv_4:11.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_4:11.text: Yeah, maybe you’re right. I don’t want to jump in without thinking, but I also want to clear the air.

p2/p2_conv_4:12.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_4:12.text: That makes sense. It could be helpful to think about what outcome you want from the conversation. How are you feeling about approaching it?

p2/p2_conv_4:13.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_4:13.text: Nervous, but I think it’s necessary. I’ve been feeling so isolated after everything that’s happened recently, and it’s exhausting.

p2/p2_conv_4:14.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_4:14.text: Isolation can definitely make everything feel a lot harder. You’re showing a lot of strength by wanting to address things and reconnect.

p2/p2_conv_4:15.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_4:15.text: Thank you. I just need to get through this rough patch. Handling school and personal issues is just a lot.

p2/p2_conv_4:16.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_4:16.text: It really is. Balancing everything isn’t easy, but I believe in your ability to get through it. I'm here to listen anytime you need.

p2/p2_conv_4:17.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_4:17.text: That means a lot. I’ll try to focus on one thing at a time and hopefully it'll get better. Thanks for being here.

p2/p2_conv_4:18.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_4:18.text: You’re doing great, even if it doesn’t feel like it right now. Keep taking it one day at a time, and reach out whenever you need support.

p2/p2_conv_4:2.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_4:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about what's been going on?

p2/p2_conv_4:3.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_4:3.text: Yeah, I think it might help. I had a fallout with a close classmate over a group project. It’s just really weighing heavily on me.

p2/p2_conv_4:4.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_4:4.text: That sounds tough. Conflicts like that can be really upsetting. Do you want to tell me more about what happened?

p2/p2_conv_4:5.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_4:5.text: We were working on this project, and I felt like I was doing most of the work. When I brought it up, it turned into a big argument.

p2/p2_conv_4:6.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_4:6.text: I can see why that would be frustrating. It sounds like you were trying to voice your feelings and it didn’t go as you hoped.

p2/p2_conv_4:7.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_4:7.text: Exactly. It felt like all the past stress from other classes just boiled over. And now, I worry about the impact on my grades and our friendship.

p2/p2_conv_4:8.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_4:8.text: Grades and relationships are both really important. It’s understandable to feel overwhelmed. Have you talked to each other since then?

p2/p2_conv_4:9.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_4:9.text: Not yet. I guess I’m scared about making things worse, you know? But I also don't like leaving things unresolved.

p2/p2_conv_5:0.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_5:0.text: Hey, I just need to talk to someone. Is that okay?

p2/p2_conv_5:1.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_5:1.text: Of course, Taylor. I'm here for you. What's on your mind?

p2/p2_conv_5:10.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_5:10.text: I just feel like I'm losing touch with the one thing that used to make me happy.

p2/p2_conv_5:11.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_5:11.text: It's understandable to feel that way when you're passionate about something. Have you thought about any small steps that might help you reconnect with your writing?

p2/p2_conv_5:12.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_5:12.text: I tried to just sit and let myself write without pressure, but the words still didn't come.

p2/p2_conv_5:13.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_5:13.text: Giving yourself some grace during this time is important. Maybe journaling or even reading could help spark some inspiration?

p2/p2_conv_5:14.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_5:14.text: That's a good idea. I've been meaning to read a book that inspired me a lot last year.

p2/p2_conv_5:15.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_5:15.text: That sounds like a wonderful way to reignite that creative spark. It's okay to take it one day at a time and find joy in small victories.

p2/p2_conv_5:16.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_5:16.text: Thanks, I appreciate it. Just talking about it makes it feel a bit more manageable.

p2/p2_conv_5:17.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_5:17.text: I'm glad to hear that. Remember, it's okay to reach out whenever you need to, and you’re not alone in this.

p2/p2_conv_5:18.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_5:18.text: I will, and thanks again for being there. I'll keep trying.

p2/p2_conv_5:19.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_5:19.text: Anytime, Taylor. You’ve got this, and I'm here whenever you need to talk.

p2/p2_conv_5:2.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_5:2.text: I've been trying to get back into writing, but it just feels impossible right now.

p2/p2_conv_5:3.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_5:3.text: Writer's block can be really tough. It sounds like you're feeling stuck. Do you want to tell me more about it?

p2/p2_conv_5:4.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_5:4.text: Yeah, it's frustrating. Every time I sit down to write, nothing comes out. It's like my mind is totally blank.

p2/p2_conv_5:5.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_5:5.text: I can imagine how disheartening that must be, given how much you care about your writing. What do you think might be contributing to these blocks?

p2/p2_conv_5:6.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_5:6.text: Well, there's been a lot going on lately. I had a big argument with my ex, and my grades haven't been great either.

p2/p2_conv_5:7.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_5:7.text: I'm sorry to hear that. It sounds like you're carrying a lot of emotional weight. It’s natural for that to affect your creative process.

p2/p2_conv_5:8.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_5:8.text: Yeah, and during exam week, I felt so isolated and anxious. It's been hard to shake off that feeling.

p2/p2_conv_5:9.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_5:9.text: That sounds really overwhelming. Being in a challenging environment and feeling isolated can certainly impact your mental space.

p2/p2_conv_6:0.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_6:0.text: Hey, I just wanted to talk about something that's been on my mind.

p2/p2_conv_6:1.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_6:1.text: Of course, Taylor. What's been going on?

p2/p2_conv_6:10.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_6:10.text: They've just been really good about listening and offering advice. They're all going through similar struggles, so it's comforting to not feel alone.

p2/p2_conv_6:2.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_6:2.text: I've been feeling really stuck and stressed lately. You remember the writer's block I mentioned before? It's still there.

p2/p2_conv_6:3.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_6:3.text: I'm sorry to hear that. It can be so frustrating when creativity feels blocked, especially with everything else you've got going on.

p2/p2_conv_6:4.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_6:4.text: Yeah, it's like I want to write, but every time I try, nothing comes out. Plus, everything that's happened recently hasn't helped.

p2/p2_conv_6:5.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_6:5.text: It sounds like you've been through a lot. That can definitely make it harder to find motivation and focus.

p2/p2_conv_6:6.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_6:6.text: Exactly. Between the argument with my ex, failing that mid-term, and falling out with my classmate... I just feel overwhelmed.

p2/p2_conv_6:7.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_6:7.text: That's a lot to deal with in a short amount of time. It makes sense that you're feeling pressured and overwhelmed.

p2/p2_conv_6:8.speaker: seeker
p2/p2_conv_6:8.text: The only positive thing recently is that I found this online community of writers. They've been really encouraging.

p2/p2_conv_6:9.speaker: supporter
p2/p2_conv_6:9.text: That's wonderful to hear! Having a supportive community can make a huge difference. How have they been helping you?
